name: The Hideout
description: The venue is a lively karaoke bar that offers a vibrant atmosphere with friendly staff and a welcoming crowd. It features a good sound system and a decent song selection, making it a great spot for both casual singing and socializing. The venue serves food and drinks, including alcohol, and is open early enough for lunch or daytime karaoke sessions. Its clean environment and fun vibe make it stand out as a go-to spot for karaoke enthusiasts seeking a relaxed yet energetic experience.
